Remark
[Eguchi--Hanson obstruction to Ricci compactness]

Source: petersen:page-0454 ↗ rem:pet-ch11-exercise-11-6-13 1. ch11:11.6.14The Eguchi--Hanson metrics show that compactness fails in general for the class $|\Ric |\le \Lambda $, $\vol B(p,1)\ge v$ alone; either a large lower volume bound (as before) or a lower conjugate-radius bound must be assumed.
